weakest_scene.visible_evidence: seg2:mid shows three cloned Data figures, one per bat-species row, pointing at empty cyan circles beside a dotted ruler. At the same moment the caption shows '90%' while the narration is about northern long-eared bats (97%). The kill rates appear only as text labels in seg2:end. Just before, seg2:start showed a plain bar chart with bat icons.
weakest_scene.root_cause: The scene fell back to a ranking/bar layout and dropped Data in as a pointer copied per row. Nothing in the picture is made of bats dying, so 97% and 90% are asserted by labels instead of being shown.
weakest_scene.repair_goal: Make the decline physical. Show a cave ceiling roost of 100 bats per species, with Data sweeping them away with a broom (or snuffing them out) until 3 remain for northern long-eared and 10 remain for little brown. The empty roost should carry the number. Keep one Data acting as the cause, and make the caption match the species on screen.
